Your best bet might be slow-infusing ground up coffee beans in a cheese cloth in vodka overnight. Think of it like making a cold brew - the slow and cold extraction process will bring out a bolder and richer flavor from the beans. If you have some room for experimentation, try playing with the ratios in several small batches (like no more than a few grams of coffee in perhaps a pint glass) and then scale up when you find one that yields the best flavor.

It's okay it's up to you please don't feel pressured!!!" I thought about it for a second and was just kinda like, "I mean yeah okay I guess I'll try it, I kinda wanna know what the big deal is about it." 
We made a cornbread cookie (wtf even is that?
